{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 1]

# Identify invalid age values (e.g., -1)
invalid_age_mask = converted_customers['customer_age'] == -1

# Drop rows with invalid age (or replace with NaN)
converted_valid = converted_customers[~invalid_age_mask]

# Compute mean age for valid converted customers
mean_age_converted = converted_valid['customer_age'].mean()

mean_age_converted"}
